hooks.name: code-review-on-write
hooks.description:
Performs a quick code review after write operations to catch common issues

Migration note: Tool categories were converted to the tool-name matcher `^(fs_write|fs_append|str_replace|delete_file|code)$`, reconstructed from the built-in tool list. Confirm it covers the tools you meant, then enable the hook.

action.prompt: Code was just written or modified. Perform a quick review checking for: 1) Common security issues (SQL injection, XSS, etc.), 2) Error handling, 3) Code clarity and maintainability, 4) Potential bugs or edge cases. Only comment if you find issues worth addressing.
